IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aas)}
def nw_band(a,b,band=25,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    ai=[IDX.get(c,22) for c in a]; bi=np.array([IDX.get(c,22) for c in b])
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,min(n,band)+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,min(m,band)+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        lo=max(1,int(i*m/n)-band); hi=min(m,int(i*m/n)+band); row=B62[ai[i-1],bi]
        for j in range(lo,hi+1):
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+row[j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(b[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append("-");ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append("-");Bb.append(b[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
ref=seqs["MAL63"]; L=len(ref); proj={"MAL63":ref}
for k,v in seqs.items():
    if k=="MAL63": continue
    a,b=nw_band(v,ref); proj[k]="".join(x for x,y in zip(a,b) if y!="-")

W=21
def win_id(q):
    d=np.array([proj[q][i]==ref[i] for i in range(L)],float)
    return np.convolve(d,np.ones(W)/W,mode="same")*100
